(ja)༄༅/ /bstan srung rnams la bskang gso dang spyan gzigs 'bul ba'i las bskul bstan pa rgyas pa'i dbyar rnga zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /swasti bi dza ya tu/sngag

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// bstan srung rnams la bskang gso dang spyan gzigs 'bul ba'i las bskul bstan pa rgyas pa'i dbyar rnga zhes bya ba bzhugs// swasti bi dza ya tu/ sngags spyod bsgom bzlas lta ba'i lcags kyu yis// ye shes 'jig rten dregs pa gang dang gang*// btab tsam rang dbang bkol ba dngos brgyud kyi// dpal ldan bla ma lha mchog gnyis su med// de dag bka' lung yi ge dam tshig gi /rdo rjes snying la bkod don rgyal ba'i bstan// de 'dzin byed pa bshad sgrub lhun len bcas// bsrung bar zhal 'ches bstan srung yongs kyi rje// ston pa'i gsang gsum sprul pa'i sems dpa' che// chos dang chos mdzad gces par skyong brtson yang*// yid srub rtsa lag bcas pa'i srog lus dag /kham zas byed pa'i gur mgon lcam dral dang*// bar chad dgra 'dres gtses pa'i 'jigs tshogs rnams// khyod zhal dran dang phrin las bskul tsam nas// mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal byed pa'i// gdong bzhi ldan pa'i dpal mgon sring bzhir bcas// bstan dgra byad ma'i rigs gyur da lta nyid// skad cig gnyis par gsod du rung ngam zhes// stong gsum kun du nyul ba'i las mkhan rje// gnod sbyin pho mo pu tra ming sring sde// gzhom bral rdo rje'i keng rus khros pa'i gzugs// yid la byas pas dgra snying bkas pa'i khrag /rgyun chen kha sgor skyugs pa hub gcig nyid// btung la rngam pa'i dur khrod yab yum gnyis// dus mtha'i me rlung 'khrugs par dbang sngon ri// zlos gar 'bum gyis rtsen bzhin srin mo'i gzugs// dran pa tsam gyis bstan pa de 'dzin la// sdang ba'i dgra srog 'phrog ma dmag zor rgyal// legs nyes las kyi drang thig ma 'khyog kyang*// bstan don lhag bsam sgrub la sdang ba'i dgra// mi bzad dus kyi kha lce glal ba'i khar// sdud byed las kyi gshin rje yum 'khor bcas// 'jigs rung gzugs kyis bskal pa'i byin za rmugs// dam tshig can la pha ltar byams pas bskyang*// sdang dgrar rbad na rngugs med thog ltar rgyug

/bka' sdod gnod sbyin beg tse lcam 'khor sogs// rdo rje 'chang nas sa skya pa yab sras// kun dga' bzang po brgyud par bcas rnams kyi// bka' lung rdo rje'i rwa bar gnas bcas pa'i// bstan srung rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// khyed rnams dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas dngos 'byor dang*// yid sprul yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon 'khyil// ge sar 'dzum pa'i me tog dga' tshal bkra// zhing kun khyab par nyul ba'i spos mchog gtul// sgrib pa'i mun 'phrog sgron ma tshar du dngar// lus dbang sim pa'i bde ster dri chab rdzing*// zag med bde bskyed ro brgya'i zhal zas brtsegs// bstod dbyangs snyan brjid rol mo 'brug stong ldir// sngags spyod grub pa'i dpa' bos dgra bgegs kyi// rnam shes skye med dbyings bsres rnam smin lus// nyer spyod bskrun pa'i khrag zhag arghaṃ dang*// dbang lnga'i me tog khrag gi sbrang bu lding*// tshil chen gu gul bsregs pa'i spos kyis ngad// rkang mar sgron mes nyin byed 'od la 'phya// mkhris pa'i dri chab gser gyi lbu phreng 'grems// sha rus zhal zas byi ru'i lhun por brtsegs// rkang gling thod rnga'i nga ros dgra snying 'dar// bstan dgra byad ma'i srog la dmigs tsam gyis// gcod byed ral gri rnon pos nyer mtshon pa'i// gzhan 'joms mtshon cha rang srung go cha'i rigs// ma hā tsi na'i 'phrul bzos btags pa'i dar// lus dbang 'jam pa'i bde ster reg bya can// dbang sngon zhun ma'i rgyan phreng brgya rtsa brgyad// bstan srung 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul// srid pa gsum na 'gran zlas ches dben pa'i// mthu stobs kho lag bskyed pa'i a mṛ ta// rnam pa dkar dmar gtor ma'i ri rab brtsegs// bstan srung 'khor bcas dgyes pas legs bzhes shig /ye shes me long nang du sems can gyi// bsam dgu mi 'tshar rnam pa ci zhig yod// 'on te bdag cag bsam pa rdzogs bya'i phyir// 'dod don phrin las bcol la rtse gcig dgongs// sa bdag chen po'i nor skal phrogs pa med// gdengs can dbang po'i gtsug nas bton min par// dpal gyi 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che// sgrib gsum zad par bza' ba gang yin dang*// ma bteg mkhas pa bye bas bsngags pas mtho// sdang sems med par nyon mongs tshogs dang 'khon// ma bskul sems can phan par 'doms pa'i chos// sa skya pa yi bstan pa ches rgyas mdzod// nyi zer phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor spro ba dang*// kun bzang bstan pa'i bshad sgrub rgyas 'gyur dpal// mtshungs kyang rgyal kun bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// ston phyir chos su nges gang rgyas par spel// dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa'i 'chad rtsom dang*// brtsad pas bka' lung 'grel byed bstan 'dzin gyi// skyes mchog ji snyed gsang gsum rdo rje dang*// g.yung drung lhun po'i rjes snyegs brling bar mdzod// gur gum rgyas pa'i nags bzhin 'dus pa'i tshogs// li khri'i tshon mdangs gsar pas phyogs kyi bzhin// bkab pa'i gsung ngag snyan dngags dbyangs 'jo bas// gdung bas nyen la bde ster mchog tu mdzod// bstan 'gror phan 'dod snying dbus bcang bdag la// phrag dog rgyud 'khrugs dri bzhon zas can gyi// byad gtad rbad zor kha rlangs spros so cog

/byad mkhan gang yin steng smin bzlog cing bsgyur// rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub pa'i dal 'byor rten// gnam lo zla ba zhag dang dus tshod kyi// keg rigs ldang dang 'byung khams gcod 'dral sogs// na shi dur zhugs gnod pa gang mchis pa// bstan srung khyed cag dran bskul bgyis pa'i 'phral// bar chad bgegs dgra'i dpung las rnam rgyal ba// ma zlum dkyil 'khor shar bas sngo bsangs mun// skad cig mi gnas 'jig pa'i rjes 'gror mdzod// tshul khrims bslab ldan rten gyi khang bzang dbus// byang chub spyod spyad lha bu gzhon nu de// 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsis rtag 'tsho zhing*// rim gnyis yon tan rin chen gter la sbyor// sbrang rtsi'i dgra bo'i rkang rdul bkrus pa med// drang srong khong khro'i kha chus bslad min pa'i// 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i legs bshad gaṅgā'i chus// log brtag smras sgrib gcod pa'i mthu ldan mdzod// gang dag brtsams dgu'i las la gegs byed kyi// bgegs dgra'i lus srog dus 'dzin khar stob pa// gnyer du gtad phyir bka' srung bsten byas kyis// btang snyoms bzhugs par rigs sam gang dgyes gsol// bla ma lha srung rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// thugs rje mthu rtsal dpag yas bden gtam rnga// sa gsum lhang nger ldir bas mngon 'dod kyi// phrin las gang bcol snye ma smin gyur cig /ces rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi ma zhes chu lug gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang por/ mgon khang nub shar gnyis su bstan srung rnams la bskang gso dang spyan gzigs 'bul ba'i las bskul bstan pa rgyas pa'i dbyar rnga zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bande tshul khrims rin chen rang gis sug bris su bgyis pa bi dza ya tu// ༈ /dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// rgyal bstan bsrung bar zhal 'ches srung ma'i tshogs// khyad par rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dregs pa las mgon dmag zor sogs// bsten kyin mchod pa'i bka' srung mthu rtsal can// thams cad phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor la// dam tshig dbang gis dgyes par rol nas ni// dgos ched bcol ba'i phrin las gsol la dgongs// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i rjes zhugs bdag cag gi

/lus ngag yid la rnam 'tshe'i nad dang gdon// lo zla zhag dus 'byung ba dgra gshed sogs// keg rigs mi mthun bar chad zhi bar mdzod// gnod byed sdang dgra mi dang mi min gyis// byas pa'i byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad kyi// nyer 'tshe thams cad bsam par brtsam pa de'i// steng du bzlog bsgyur las ngan rgyun chod cig /ring 'tsho'i tshe ni gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar bsrings// bsod nams las bzang dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing*// phrin las nyi zla'i 'od ltar ches gsal bas// byang chub spyod mtha' rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrubs// zhes chu rta'i lo'i bstan srung tshogs la gegs sel phrin las bskul ba'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di'ang bande tshul khrims rin chen rang gis sug bris su bgyis pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wantu// ༈ /sdom gsum brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha// bstan srung ma hā kā la lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon sring bzhi dur khrod bdag /las mgon dmag zor la sogs bstan srung rnams// bshams sprul mchod gtor mthun rdzas 'bul bzhes nas// sbyin bdag sgo gsum bar chad kun zhi zhing*// nad rims gdon bgegs mi dang lha 'dre yi// brtsams pa'i gnod pa mi 'byung bzlog par mdzod// nad med tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod dpal// thos bsam bsgom pa bcas rnams 'phel zhing rgyas// skye 'gro dbang sdud mi mthun dgra tshogs las// rnam par rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par mdzod// ces sna tshogs zhes pa'i gnam lo'i nyi zlog skabs kyi mgon khang nub shar du bstan srung rnams la bskang gso 'dod don gsol ba'i rkang mgyogs zhes pa 'di'ang kun dga' blo gsal gyi ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// ༈ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha// rdo rje gur mgon dral lcam gdong bzhi ldan// dur khrod yab yum las mgon dmag zor sogs// bsten cing sgrub pa'i lha srung thams cad dgongs// 'tsho ba'i dus 'das kun dga' rgya mtsho pas// gzhan don bla med byang chub gnas bgrod la// sa dang lam gyi bar chad kun bsgral nas// mngon dga'i zhing sogs myur skyel phrin las mdzod// rim gyis bde ba can sogs sangs rgyas zhing*// rdzu 'phrul gyis bgrod thos pa'i chos mdzod bzung*// lung rtogs yon tan gya nom mngon bgyis na// rnam 'phrul bye bas 'gro don 'byung bar mdzod// ces mgon khang chen por kun dga' rgya mtsho 'da' ka ma'i smon lam 'grub pa'i grogs bcol gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang*/

bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa'o// ༈ /dpag yas tshogs gnyis chu gter bsrubs las skyes// sku gsum go 'phang bde 'byung thod na spa// legs gsungs 'od dkar 'dzad med 'byung ba'i gnas// ston mchog bsil sbyin mkhan de gtsug tu mchod// 'jig rten gsum na mdo sngags chos tshul gyi// bdud rtsi dam pa stsal drin che ba'i zla// tshangs pas bskal pa lu gu brgyud btsal yang*// ma rnyed mi mchog rang nyid mtshungs dper bstan// bsod nams brgya pa'i gzugs sku tshur mthong gi /lta byed yul las bskal yang thub dbang bka'// tshad mas bskrun dang gzugs brnyan dngos mjal dang*// bsod nams mnyam par bsngags brjod skal ba sbom// chu 'dzin 'khun sgras myos pa'i mdongs mtha' can// yid 'phrog 'gram chang gis btab ba ku la// nyag gcig skyabs kyi dam pa sangs rgyas kyi// sku brnyan mthong bas skal bzang rab dga' rgyas// g.yar lam lus brgya mngon sprul bstod phyag 'tshal// gtsang sbyar nyer spyod mchod pa tshar du dngar// gser zhun thags su bskrun lta'i dar yug 'bul// rang bzhin bcas pa'i nyes ltung bshags shing sdom// skye 'phags kyis bsags dge bar rjes yi rang*// smra mchog kun la chos sgra 'byin pa dang*// mya ngan mi 'dar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge tshogs rnam pa thams cad mkhyen rgyur bsngo// ston pa'i chos tshul sgor zhugs rgyal sras kyi// spyod khrims slob 'dun brtul zhugs bzung ba des// rin thang gzhal med thub chen sku brnyan la// snyan dngags dbyangs kyis mchod pa 'di 'bul lo// dal rten dga' tshal sdom gsum 'dab brgya bzhad// bcu phrag rig pa'i ge sar ros myos pa'i// mkhas tshul gsum gyi bung ba'i mgrin glu mkhan// 'di nas byang chub bar du bdag skyer mdzod// ces nyi ma zhes pa'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi rgyal ba dang por gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon dgar bzhugs pa'i thub chen sku mdun la mchod 'bul bung ba'i mgrin glu zhes pa bande tshul khrims rin chen rang gis sug bris su bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu//

༈ /thub dbang ye shes me long nang*// mdo sngags chos la mkhas tshul gsum// yang dag bgyid par shar ba'i 'phrin// lung bstan snyan pa kun dga' bzang*// gang sku yid ches lung tshad kyis// nyer bskrun ring bsrel phung po can// dus gsum bde gshegs 'dus sku cher// byin rlabs mthong ba don ldan la// phyag 'tshal nyer spyod phreng ba dang*// stong 'khun dar gyis mchod byas pas// kho bo ltos bcas tshe rabs kun// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'bab stegs mdzod// ces rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan la mchod 'bul gyi tshe/ 'dod gsol 'di'ang bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ /dpalaṃ gyi 'byung gnas skal ba drug ldanaṃ bdag /sangs rgyas go 'phang gshegs pa'i stobs rdzogs kyang*// dus 'dir lung rtogs chosaṃ tshul skyongaṃ ba la// rab dgyes bshes gnyen rnam rol gang des srungs// sems can khams su bde skyid gzhon nu'i mgron// 'gugs byed mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan rlabs// 'og min bar du lud pa'i legs mdzad kyi// rtogs brjod rin chen 'byung gnas chen po las// gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sku// theg chen chos kyis dga' bar ldan pa'i gnas// mi pham rgyal ba'i sras kyi zhal lung gis// spangs rtogs snye ma smin phyir gshegs mdzad kyang*// deng 'dir rdo rje slob dpon sgyu 'phrul sku'i// bkod pas gdul bya'i lhag ma rnams kyi rgyud// dge tshogs bsags par bskul phyir skuṃ gdungaṃ gi /ring bsrel ril po nyid du bzhag pa gang*// snying pos sbum pa'i rtenaṃ mchoṃg manda raḥ /chos ldan sa skyong sdeṃ dgeṃ blaṃ maṃ che// bloṃ groṃs rgyaṃ mtshoṃs byang chub spyod pa'i mtsho// dad stobs ma dmad ri bos bsrubs las skyes// sngon rabs dgeṃ 'dunaṃ bye ba mchog zung gis// legs 'dumasaṃ mdzad pa'i dge mtshan yangs can du// byung ba dper byas mchoṃd sdongaṃ sridaṃ dang zhiṃ'i// dpalaṃ kunaṃ 'dzad med 'jo ba'iṃ dpagaṃ bsaṃm dbaṃng*// gang la phyag mchod bgyis pa'i rnam dkar gyi// zom stegs la brten 'gro ba su yang rung*// ngan 'gro srid pa'i 'jigs pa rgyang ring du// bgyid pa rgyal ba'i sras kyi smon lam shugs// dus gsum sangs rgyas de sras slob mar bcas// bskal par mchod pas rdo rje slob dpon sku'i// ba spu skye ba'i go rer mchod byas pa'i// bsod nams phung por mi sgrun rgyal ba'i bka'// de sogs dpag yas che ba'i yon tan las// cha phran blangs pa snyan dngags dam pa'i glu// song ba yi ge'i rgyud mangs brdung dang mnyam// sprul pa'i lus mang btud pas phyag bgyi'o// yon tan zhing rab dgyes pa'i nye bar spyod// mchod yon rdzing bu'i rlabs kyi lag pa bskyod// sna tshogs me tog khrod kyi ge sar dgod// dri zhim bdug pa'i na bun mkha' la 'khrigs// ma rig sngo bsangs 'phrog pa'i sgron me sbar// reg pa bde ster spos chu'i dri chab sbreng*// mdzes pa'i zhal zas ro drug bcud ldan bstar// snyan dngags bstod dbyangs rol mo snyan par 'khrol// ma hā tsi na'i yul grur 'phrul bzo yis// bkra shis ri mo bkrag cher thags bskrun gyi// gan dar gyis mtshon blo yi tshangs pa yis// mngon par sprul pa'i kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul// sdom pa'i bslab bya dug gsum gyis myos tshe// dam bca'i yi ge gsubs par srid pa yi// 'khor lo'i gzugs brnyan mthong ba'i bzhin gnag pas// sdig ltung mthol bshags dag pa'i tshangs par stsol// legs byas byed po'i lhag bsam kha ba'i rdul// dpag yas brtsegs pa'i bsod nams gangs can ri// kun la yi rang bsil sbyin gzhon nu yis// rnam par bklubs pa ches dkar nyid du bgyi// phyogs kyi sgeg mo'i bzhin ras yongs bkab par// 'tsho gzhes bzhugs pa'i mi mchog thams cad la// bar med chos kyi smra dbyangs rtag 'jo bas// sgrib gnyis stug po'i gnyid las slong bar bskul// sangs rgyas sems dpa' che gang mya ngan las// yongs su 'da' la dgyes bzhed mi 'gog mod// 'gro ba mgon med sdug bsngal rgyur bcas kyis// gdungs pa'i cho nge thos tshe mi 'gyod tshal// rnam dkar dge ba'i zla bas sgrib gsum gyi// mun pa yongs zos tshogs zung chu bo'i gter// ches cher rgyas pa'i rnam mkhyen chu bdag ches// legs gsungs dag byed rgyun mang 'gyed par shog

/rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab kun bzang brgyud bcas kyi// lugs mchog bskal pa'i bar du 'phel ba'i zla// sprin dus gnam 'phyo'i grong khyer kho na yi// rjes 'gro gzhan gyis sgrun min dar gyur cig /bdag cag 'di nas bla med byang chub bar// dal 'byor skye bar tshulaṃ khrimaṃs bslab pas brgyan// bcu phrag rig pa'i snang chen yongs bzung nas// bstan 'gror phan pa'i chos smra kun gyi gtsug /ngal gso'i nor bu rin chen nyid byin rlobs// ces chu lug gi bgrang gzhi gsar tshes kyi 'du chen 'dus tshogs su tshe dpag med kyi sgrub mchod gsung bskul dang*/ mchod gnas ji snyed bzhugs pas kho bor ring 'tsho sgrub pa'i bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed stob pa'i tshe/ mchod sdong srid zhi'i dpal kun 'jo ba'i dpag bsam chen por yan lag bdun pa'i mchod 'bul dri za'i dbyangs snyan bya ba 'di ni/ bande tshul khrims rin chen rang gis sug bris su bgyis pa maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rnam 'dren yongs kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rtsal// nyi ma'i bus mtshon bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i phyir// 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul khro rgyal brtan g.yo'i bdag /ye shes lnga bdag rdo rje 'jigs byed skur// nyer spyod kyis mchod snyan dar gsol ba'i mthus// bdag cag ltos 'khor bcas pa byang chub mchog /sgrub pa'i bar chad bdud dang gshin rje yi// 'jigs pa kun las bsrung zhing bskyab par mdzod// ring 'tsho'i tshe yi skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun// tshad med bsod nams sa gzhir 'khyil ba'i nang*// bskyed rdzogs 'dab rgyas ngang pa'i ded dpon des// mkhas tshul mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol bar mdzod// ces rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku brnyan la 'dod gsol dad pa'i rdza rnga zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bande tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// ༈ /swasti bi dza yantu/ gang gsung dbyangs kyi 'gyur khugs rdzogs pa las// theg gsum mtshan rtogs skyob pa'i chos sgra yis// khams gsum gdul bya mngon mtho nges legs kyi// thabs dang 'bras bur sbyor ba rdzogaṃs sangaṃs rgyasaṃ// de bstan gangs can snang byed grangs med khrod// lha rigs daṃd sgrolaṃ rnamaṃ lngaraṃ mtshungs pa su// dga' tshal 'dab stong dgod pa mang srid kyang*// u dumbā ra gnyis pa cang mchis sam// lung rtogs chos smra'i rgyal por thub pa'i bkas// lung bstan skyes bu khyod kyi lugs bzang la// dad blo 'phel ba tsam du tshul gzhan la// de lta min 'di ci ga kunaṃ dgaṃ' bzaṃng*// de tshul dri med srid pa'i khongs 'di na// brling byed chos spyod rnam bcu lhur len pa'i// 'dus pa'i khur gyis nor ldan brtan ma'i lus// ngal ba'i shugs ring dbyangs su 'byin nam snyam// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor thams cad lhunaṃ grubaṃ tu// rtag par 'jo bas sa stengaṃ rgyan gyur pa// gang bsamaṃ 'grubaṃ par smon pa'i lam song ba// bde stsol mthoṃng naṃ mngoṃn dgaṃ'i gtsugaṃ lagaṃ khangaṃ*// bstan pa'i gzhi dang snying por gyur pa'i chos// sdom pa gsum gyi bslab gzhir skal ba can// legs sbyar thar pa'i go sar bgrod pa'i tshul// dngos dang brgyud nas 'doms mdzad bla ma'i tshogs// gang sku bsgom zhing gsang ba sngags kyi sgras// gsang gsum mi phyed rdo rjer bskul tsam gyis// dngos grub rnam gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs kyi mchog

/gong 'og rgyud sdes nyer bstan yi dam lha// bsam kun rdzogs byed mthong chos mngon 'dod kyi// mngon par gdung la bsam 'phel nor bu yis// srid pa mya ngan las 'das mngon 'dod dpal// gang dag gsol la dkon mchog rnam gsum gyis// chu bzhi'i bye snyed kun bzod phra rab rdul// ltos 'gro'i pho brang chen po'i chu thigs grangs// rjes 'gro rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba sras// thos sgrogs rkyen rtogs 'phags pa grangs med bcas// sgyu 'phrul mthu stobs kho nas gur gyi mgon// lcam dral bstan srung mchog tu bsngags min yang*// dam tshig can la 'go zhing bcol ba'i las// thogs med sgrub pa'i phrin las 'dis yang ngo*// zhal bzhi dpal mgon khros pa'i 'jigs rung sgras// yid srubs dregs pa'i nga ro'i gnyen por byas// gdong mig dmar zlum bltas tsam bstan dgra'i srog /mthar byed gnam lcags rdo rje'i gzugs kyi zla// bstan pa de 'dzin bsrung bar mngon brtson pa'i// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring sdes// bstan dgra dam nyams lo zlar 'tsho ba'i rgyun// 'gyang min lnga lam 'khrid byed tshogs kyis mtshon// rnam 'dren bstan pa srung la dgyes pa'i 'dzum// dkar pos khor yug 'gengs mod chu srin gyi// rgyal mtshan sder bcas mi sdug gdong bsgyur te// tshar gcod rno mtshon char bsnyil bka' srung tshogs// chos srid stobs 'byor gyis rgyags lus can gyi// rkang drug mtha' dag dad dga'i 'phur lding gis// dpal 'byor sbrang rtsi'i skyes dang lhan cig nyid// sdud byed nor lha'i tshogs bcas thams cad la// bdag lus gcig nyid du ma'i sprul phyag gi /grangs med chu zla'i ngo mtshar nyung ngur byas// tha dad che ba'i yon tan snyan dngags dbyangs// bstod pas dri za'i 'phang 'gro'i tshul la 'thab// ma hā tsi na'i yul gyi 'phrul bzo yis// rab dmar byi ru zhun ma'i rgyu spun bzang*// gser gyi sgra brgya tshon lnga'i ri mo bcas// thags su bskrun pa'i gan gos yug ring 'phan// mchod yul spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin gyis gtibs// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid gtsor bzhugs pa'i// bag yod bslab pa bcas dang ma bcas pa'i// mchod gnas bsnyen bkur bstabs mtshon dge ba'i tshogs// lha rigs 'khon ston saṃ skyaṃ paṃ yi gduṃng*// rgyun mi chad pa bskal par 'byon 'gyur zhing*// bstan srid phrin las nyi zla'i snang ba ches// gser ldan dkyil 'khor khyab par gsal gyur cig

/zab yangs chos kyi 'byung gnas eṃ dang waṃ// zung 'jug dge mtshan ldan pa'i che mchog gi /tshul chen rjes su sgrub dang smra byad pas// dbyig 'dzin lus phra'i khur du lci bar shog /srid par lus rten bskyed drin che ba zung*// ltos bcas gson gshin thog drangs 'gro ba'i rgyud// tshogs zung dbyar skyes rkang 'thung bskyed pa'i khrod// rnam grol 'bras bu g.yur du za bar shog /srid pa'i 'khor lor sdug bsngal kun 'byung gis// bar med gtses pa'i mar gyur sems can rnams// gdon phyir bdag ni thabs dang thugs rje'i gter// thams cad mkhyen pa thob bgyi de srid du// tshulaṃ khrimaṃs rten bzang lhun po bzhin du brling*// tshe dpal 'byor pa dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin 'phel// bsod nams gser ldan ma bzhin yangs par brdal// phrin las riṃn chenaṃ snang ba ches 'bar shog /sngags spyod bden tshig grub pa'i ma harṣiḥ /sgrib gnyis bcud bral 'phrul las rnam rgyal nas// gnas lnga rig pa'i dag byed btung ba'i mthar// legs bshad chu klung 'bum phrag skyugs par shog /legs byas dkar po'i mtshar sdug zur mig gis// dge bcur spyod pa'i lang tsho dar bab mgron// bod chen yangs pa'i sdum par bkug pa la// skye bo'i tshogs 'di dgyes dgur rtsen gyur cig /ces rab byung 'dod pa'i chu lug gi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi gral tshes dge bar/ gyi na pas lhun grub steng gtsug lag khang du 'du chen 'dus tshogs su tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod 'dzugs pa sogs gsar rnying chos sgrogs par bcas pa'i mchod gnas gang dag bzhugs par bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed stob pa'i tshe/ gtsug lag khang du brgya mchod dang gan gos kyi 'phan bcas phul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dge legs g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ bande tshul khrims rin chen rang gis sug bris su bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu//

༈ /sarbartha siddhyantu/ bka' babs dngos brgyud bla ma dbyer med pa'i// dgyes rdor la sogs yi dam bkas bsgos ltar// phrin las myur mgyogs sgrub mdzad bstan srung gtso// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang*// las bzhi lhun grub gnyen mgon gdong bzhi ldan// 'jigs rung yum bzhi gnod sbyin pho mo dang*// pu tra ming sring ru 'dren dur khrod bdag /dmag zor la sogs bstan srung tshogs rnams dgongs// bsten kyin 'go ba'i lha srung gnyen po rnams// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod gtor 'bul bzhes la// dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung mthol bzhes nas// bcol pa'i phrin las gsol 'di sgrub par rigs// rnal 'byor dpon slob lo zla zhag dus kyi// na shi dur zhugs keg dang dus min 'chi'i// nad gdon bar chad mi dang mi min gyi// gnod pa thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// sngon las 'phral gyi rkyen sri gang ldang yang*// mthu chen khyed cag mi 'dul 'ga' med phyir// yus pa'i bu chung ma la ngud mo yi// sbron ltar 'bod la thugs brtses ma g.yel zhig /zhi bas ma thul dbang drag phrin las rtsal// gnam lcags thog brgya 'bebs 'dras tshar bcad de// gus ldan 'khor bcas nad med ring 'tsho zhing*// thos bsam bsgom sogs brtsams dgu 'grub par mdzod// zas spyod nyes sam byad ma'i sdang sems byas// sde brgyad 'byung po'i rbod gtong gang yin rung*// thams cad phyir bzlog slan chad mi 'byung bar// srung skyob rdo rje'i rwa bar rtag gnas mdzod// ces bstan srung tshogs la rkyen sel bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi nye bar gnas pa lhun grub phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen can gyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ /swasti siddhaṃ/ phyogs bcu'i lus med thul mchog sras dang bcas// thugs bskyed smon lam rjes dgongs skye 'gro'i rgyud// tshogs rdzogs mchod yul sprin ltar gtibs pa'i gnas// bsam 'grub mthong na mngon dga'i dri gtsang khang*// mar gad zhun 'dra'i lha rdzas gos 'phan dang*// dge 'dun 'dus pas kun rig rtsa dkyil 'khor// sgrub mchod dbang blangs bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed bcas// dge slong nam mkha' phun tshogs can gyis phul// dge ba yang srid kun du bla ma lha// dkon mchog gsum po mchod pas mnyes bgyid cing*// lung rtogs dam pa'i chos la rtag tu spyod// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/

bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ /swasti siddhi rastu/ rnam 'dren thub pa'i 'dzum sgros utpal dmar// dgyes 'dzum 'dab mnyen rnam par grol ba las// lung bstan rkang drug glu yis bsngags pa'i yul// rgyal tshab kun dga' bzang pos rtag tu srungs// dad sgrol de nyid thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyi// rnam rol smra mkhas bye bas gdul bya rnams// mdo sngags chos tshul theg pa la brten nas// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen par 'khrid pa'i gnas// srid pa'i duḥkhas yid 'byung thar pa'i grong*// dang por 'jug slad 'og min gzhal med khang*// 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i thig ler 'phos snyam la// e waṃ yi ges nyer mtshan gtsug lag khang*// dpag yas phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba sras// slob ma bstan srung mtha' dag rdul gcig gor// rdul snyed zhing gi bkod pa rab rdzogs pa'i// yon tan gnas kyis gtams pa thams cad la// bdag lus chu gter chen po'i rdul snyed grangs// kun nas btud pa'i phyag 'tshal phreng ba brtsegs// skye bar bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams// gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol bshags tshangs par stsol// nyer spyod phreng dang rgyal srid 'dod yon lnga// tsi na'i 'phrul bzos bskrun pa'i gos 'phan 'bul// so sor skye dang 'phags bzhis dge tshogs la// yi rang sems kyi zla 'od gsar pas spel// smra mchog grub pa kun la chos kyi sgra// chad med sgrogs par bskul ba'i thal sbyar btud// rgyal ba rgyal sras mya ngan 'da' bzhed rnams// gzhan don bzhugs pa'i gsol 'debs dbyangs su 'byin// 'dis mtshon bsod nams thams cad sems can kun// bla med byang chub 'khrid phyir yongs su bsngo// bdag cag bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gus// yang dag lam gyi thos bsam bsgom mthar phyin// lung rtogs yon tan gter la dbang 'byor zhing*// don gnyis lhun grub go 'phang phyin par shog

/ces e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du gos 'phan yan lag bdun pa bcas phul ba bsod nams sprin chen zhes bya ba 'di'ang a srung can gyi ched du/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ /swasti bi dza ya tu/ skyes bu chen po'i sku la brgya phrag gi /bsod nams mes pos bris pa'i dge mtshan las// dpal mgur chos kyi 'byung gnas mtshon pa'i rdzas// bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i chos dung dkar// dbyangs snyan 'jo la mkhas pas bus pa'i sgras// 'phags bzhi so skye'i mchod yul grangs med yongs// ring nas mgron gnyer dbyangs kyis mchod byed pa'i// 'bud dung rnam gnyis mdzes pa'i gan dar dbul// dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i chos tshul gyi// dga' ston mgron du lus can yongs sdud cing*// bslab khrims spyod pa'i bshad sgrub dri med kyis// rgyal bstan rin chen rgyas rgyur dge ba bsngo// zhes lhun grub steng gi chos dung zung la bsngags pa bshad sgrub rgyas glu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
